scientific_integrity: All five asymptotics are derived from exact distribution formulas. Finite numerical checks are supplementary and are not treated as proofs of infinite limits. Literature comparisons distinguish the source qualitative zero statements and their non-sharp bounds from the sharp endpoint equivalents stated here.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is pointwise for fixed positive standardized threshold and concerns the canonical endpoint witness paths used in the source. The Beta result is restricted to \(\operatorname{Beta}(1,q)\); it does not optimize jointly over both Beta shapes. No uniformity in the threshold is claimed.
title: Five endpoint laws behind vanishing standardized anti-concentration
